notes.title: [Patch Notes:Ver1.1255] Improved Keyboard and Mouse controls
notes.content:
[list]
[*]Improved Keyboard and Mouse control.
[*]Added Keymapping and Mouse sensitivity setting in Option.
[*]Assigned "back" to BackSpace key or B button in game menu.
[*]Fixed gunsight movement speed for Mouse control.
[*]Fixed small bugs, and improved stability.
[*]Fixed network progams.(not compatible with order version)
[/list]

notes.title: Demo(beta version) has relased
notes.content:
[url=http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27605933/cc9fde07a377f606c8779505ca70ea2379d6b54d.png][img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27605933/ffe2395230e6f0556cb2b85b643b5f0a758d7b92.png[/img][/url]
Hello everyone!

We've relased a free demo version for Soul Saber 2. 
You can download the demo version from "Download Demo" in the right colunm.

[b]This is a BETA version.[/b] 
It may be containing problems that released version doesn't have.

The demo version has following limitations.:
[list]
[*]Fewer usable characters, and no unlock for new characters.
[*]Available modes are only Free Battle(single player) and Online Battle(multi player).
[*]Playable time for Free balttle is limited to 60 seconds.[/list]
There are no limitations for online battle, you will be able to fight with players of full version too.

Enjoy!

notes.content:

Hello everyone!

Now, we are just working on new language translations.
In the initial release, [b]Japanese, English, Spanish, Simplified Chinese[/b], and [b]Traditional Chinese[/b] will be supported.

We are so sorry to tell that, the relase date is not in this month, but not very far future. We will announce it as soon as possbile, so please be petient!

Thank you.
